name: sandbox-mode
description: Sandbox mode: a site built from biome/kit/seed starts from nothing, honours the seed, and is fully playable through to a blast (#504: 3-control setup).

steps.description: No new_game first — a sandbox site is created from nothing, which is the point of the mode. #1671: with no staffed: flag the site opens on the chosen kit's free crew, fleet and buildings (crew, drill rig, charging truck, debris hauler, freight warehouse, spoil heap), so the full drill/charge/blast cycle needs no purchases. Interaction mode (#1671): a player opens the Sandbox panel from the main menu, picks biome, the Digger kit and the seed, and clicks Start — no console command stands in. #1731: ore depth reads 'from 0 m down' (no 999) and each vehicle reads 'Type (Model)'. #1686: before picking the final settings the player previews Volcanic Flats with the Full kit and the details elements (description, hardness, ores, terrain, starting cash, opening) appear -- every wait is on a condition, no fixed delay.

interaction.expectedValue: Ash-flat plains over hard, ore-rich volcanic rock.
Ores: Dirtite, Rustite, Blingite, Gloomium, Sparkium, Craktonite, Absurdium, Treranium (from 0 m down)

Opens with: crew: 1× Driller, 1× Blaster, 3× Driver; vehicles: 1× Drill Rig (Pokey McPoke), 1× Debris Hauler (Dumpster on Wheels), 1× Charging Truck (Pour-Bucket Pete), 1× Rock Digger (The Scratch), 1× Rock Fragmenter (Cracky); buildings: 1× Freight Warehouse (The Pile), 1× Spoil Heap (The Dump), 1× Explosive Warehouse (Boom Closet)

steps.description: Biome and seed should match what was asked for. Grid extents are the fixed 64x32x64 default regardless of request (#504).

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:4 depth:6 start:15,20
steps.description: #553: shrunk from the original rows:3 cols:3 (9 holes, start:20,20) to 2x2 (4 holes) so the single driller/drill_rig lands the whole plan quickly -- this file's point is a full drill/charge/blast cycle actually working, not a specific hole count. #1151: moved from start:10,10 to start:14,17 for climb-reachability. #1263: moved again, from start:14,17 to start:15,20, after the CREW_SPAWN_AGENT_SEPARATION fix (this same issue) changed where the staffed roster's own five employees and four vehicles land under this seed -- one of them (the blaster) now spawns exactly on (14,17) itself, so a drill_rig sent to drill H1 there was blocked by an employee standing on its own destination cell forever (orderedHoleCount stuck at 1). start:15,20's four holes -- (15,20) (19,20) (15,24) (19,24) -- collide with no employee or vehicle spawn cell. Confirmed via a direct 6000-tick trace: all four land by tick 45 (this step's own max_ticks keeps its existing 600-tick headroom).

#553: drain the ordered plan -- the staffed driller/drill_rig lands all 4 holes. #1151: was a hand-measured `tick 60` pad, replaced with a waitUntil on the thing actually being waited for, per dev-scenario-authoring -- a stall now fails loudly and by name instead of silently handing the next step an undrilled plan. #1263: start:15,20's plan (see the step above) lands all 4 holes at tick 45, measured via a direct trace -- max_ticks:600 keeps ample headroom over that.

expect.note: All 4 holes have landed -- none lost, none left ordered forever.

steps.description: #2118: the digger kit's starter warehouse holds 100 kg of Krackle, so the charge draws from that stock with no delivery wait.

#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing. #1263: this used to stall here forever (never reaching 0) regardless of the drill plan's own coordinates -- every charge target beyond the crew's immediate spawn cluster required a foot leg through a single climb-legal corridor cell a spawned-but-never-dispatched vehicle permanently occupied, and the per-hop ground-cell occupancy check (AgentAdvance.ts) had no exemption for a foot leg already planned to cross vehicle-occupied ground. Fixed at the source (AgentAdvance.ts/Locomotion.ts/PlanItinerary.ts), not by picking yet another coordinate -- every foot destination beyond that corridor hit the identical stall. With the fix, start:15,20's four charges land by tick 30, measured via a direct trace; max_ticks:3000 keeps ample headroom.
A second site with a different biome, starting kit and seed, to confirm the mode can be re-entered.

expect.note: kit:full starts at $250,000 (SANDBOX_KITS.full.startingCash, Sandbox.ts) -- grid extents stay the fixed 64x32x64 default (#504) regardless of biome/kit, same as the first site.
